title: talál and vásárol: Finding and Buying

sections.title: From looking to finding to buying
sections.content: talál ("to find") and vásárol ("to buy, to shop") are the natural next steps after keres. Both are regular verbs. vásárlás ("shopping, a purchase") is the noun form — it's the word in this unit's Hungarian title, Vásárlás és árak.

items.english: I'm buying a gift for Károly.

sections.content: találom is the definite conjugation of talál, from A1 — use it whenever the thing you're finding is a specific, already-named thing (ezt a pulóvert), the same rule that's applied to every verb since A1.
